Suppliers: Support our Financial Accountant on accounts payable: processing invoices, supplier onboarding, reconciling accounts, and being a reliable point of contact for our suppliers.
Employees: Manage the employee expense process: reviewing claims, reconciling corporate cards, employee reimbursements and keeping a high standard on details required without slowing the business down.
Cross-functional support: Be the first port of call for finance questions from teams across Halter: clear, fast, and helpful, every time.
Process improvement: Spot the gaps, fix the clunky stuff, and build better ways of working. We want someone who improves the system, not just runs it.
Month-end: Support close activities related to AR, AP and expenses, keeping our financial records accurate and audit-ready.

Experience in an accounts, finance operations, or accounts administration role, ideally across AP, AR or expenses. Sharp, numbers-hungry graduates who are keen to learn fast are welcome too.
Sharp attention to detail. You notice the things others miss, and you chase them down until they're resolved.

Comfortable operating at pace, with ambiguity, and without a playbook for everything.

Set the strategy: Define and execute the roadmap that returns the market to sustainable growth and profitability across customer acquisition, retention, pricing and margin.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Associate Product Operations Manager to support our Product organization in improving operational efficiency, cross-functional alignment, and consistency in how work moves through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC).

Working closely with, and at the direction of, the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team, this role will execute the day-to-day tactics that keep our Product Operating Model running smoothly, while building the experience and judgment to take on greater ownership over time.
Align: work closely with the Product Leadership, Senior Product Operations Manager, Product Managers, and cross-functional business partners to help ensure product work is clearly understood, decisions are communicated effectively, and teams stay aligned on priorities, dependencies, and readiness.
Enable: Help provide product teams with the means to complete routine and strategic tasks as efficiently as possible, by supporting key processes, maintaining tools and workflows, and bringing structure to how work is prepared, reviewed, and tracked.
Improve: Support continuous, iterative improvement of how teams work by helping identify bottlenecks, reducing time spent on non-core product activities, and reinforcing the systems, governance, and operating rhythms that support high-quality product work.

Product Operations is a multifaceted function that focuses on improving how the Product organization operates day to day, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enabling product teams to focus on what they do best: build great products. This role is a mixture of hands-on execution and support for continuous improvement, working under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team. In this role you will be responsible

Product Operating Model and Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) Support: Support the flow of work from intake through discovery, assessment, planning, and delivery by helping ensure requests are complete, handoffs are clear, and the right information is available at the right time.
Intake and Initiative Readiness: Support the intake process by serving as a first line of review for incoming requests. Work with stakeholders to gather required inputs and help ensure work is ready for Product review and decision-making.
Operating Rhythm and Meeting Support: Help prepare, coordinate, and, where appropriate, facilitate recurring forums such as Weekly Business Reviews, roadmap reviews, stakeholder meetings, and leadership sessions. Ensure materials are organized, decisions are captured, and follow-up actions are tracked to completion.
Tools and Workflow Optimization: Maintain the product management tech stack, including workflow hygiene, documentation practices, and reporting accuracy, and flag opportunities to improve transparency and usability across Product and cross-functional teams.
Governance and Process Support: Support key operating processes including compliance reviews, cross-functional readiness, and other recurring governance needs that help the business interact effectively with Product.
Cross-functional Project and Program Support: Support the execution of select cross-functional initiatives directed by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Managers, helping track alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across teams.
Data-informed Execution: Help gather and organize data, reporting, and operational insights to support the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership in identifying trends and informing process improvements.
Iterative Improvement: Help ensure product operating processes, frameworks, and methodologies remain practical and fit for purpose. Support the rollout of improvements as directed, with a bias toward progress over perfection.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Support open communication and help facilitate alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders, ensuring teams are working effectively toward common goals.
Team Support: Support onboarding, training, and documentation efforts led by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership, helping build repeatable ways of working across the Product Organization.

Experience: 2-5 years in product operations, program management, project management, product management, or a similar role, ideally within a technology or product-focused organization.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcomed.
Skill Set
Product Operations is a strategic support function for the business that is as much about coordinating people as it is technology and processes. The strongest candidates will be comfortable owning tactical, day-to-day operational work while building the skills to help identify ways to improve how the organization works over time.
Predominantly, candidates from product operations, program or project management, business operations, product management, business analysis, or similar roles may bring the right mix of execution, organization, and process improvement experience to the position.
An understanding of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including intake, discovery, assessment, planning, release, and cross-functional readiness processes.
Works iteratively and pragmatically - eager to help improve the way teams work over time without over-engineering or trying to change everything at once.
A logical and analytical mindset, with a developing ability to understand what can be changed, what value change can bring, and comfort using data to support recommendations.
An empathetic attitude to truly understand the problems you are trying to support and solve with your colleagues and stakeholders.
Comfort with ambiguity, resilience to change, and the ability to adapt while working across multiple priorities and teams.
Experience managing task management and workflow tools - e.g. Jira, Linear, Asana, Productboard, or similar platforms.
Ability to help maintain, organize, and refine knowledge bases and documentation structures using the most suitable information architecture and documentation solution at hand - e.g. Confluence, Notion, etc.
Ability to help use product, process, or operational data to support better decision-making and surface relevant insights from available reporting and analytics.
Experience supporting the administration, adoption, and improvement of software tools and workflows in general.
Comfort supporting meetings and presentations with multiple stakeholders, with growing confidence in facilitating and presenting over time.
Comfort working with all levels of the business - from senior leaders to individual contributors - and a willingness to make suggestions and support positive change under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership.

RoboService bringt humanoide Roboter aus der Forschung in den industriellen Alltag. Wir arbeiten mit führenden Robotik-Herstellern weltweit und setzen Robotik-Projekte bei großen Industrieunternehmen und innovativen Mittelständlern um.
Für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir eine außergewöhnlich starke Persönlichkeit, die einen geschäftskritischen Bereich von Grund auf mit aufbaut. Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, arbeitest zunächst selbst hands-on und hast die Chance, mit unserem Wachstum daraus deinen eigenen Bereich und perspektivisch ein Team aufzubauen.
Wir suchen einen smarten, unternehmerischen Generalisten, der komplexe Situationen schnell strukturiert, Herstellerbeziehungen aufbaut, überzeugend verhandelt und aus einer Sales-Pipeline eine verlässliche operative Umsetzung macht.
Du arbeitest dabei direkt mit unserem Founder & CEO Frederik Fleck zusammen, der auf über 25 Jahre Erfahrung als Tech-Unternehmer und mehrere erfolgreiche Unternehmens-Exits zurückblickt. Neben der operativen Verantwortung bekommst du dadurch direktes unternehmerisches Mentoring und einen sehr unmittelbaren Einblick in den Aufbau eines ambitionierten Technologieunternehmens.
Aufgaben
Deine wichtigste Aufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass RoboService zur richtigen Zeit über die richtigen Roboter, Komponenten und Partner verfügt – und unsere Kundenprojekte zuverlässig umgesetzt werden können.
Du übersetzt unsere Sales-Pipeline und geplante Kundenprojekte in eine vorausschauende operative Planung und sorgst dafür, dass Ressourcen, Hardware und Partner rechtzeitig verfügbar sind.
Du koordinierst unsere Kundenprojekte von Auftrag bis Deployment und stellst sicher, dass technische Teams, Compliance, Lieferanten und Kunden auf einer gemeinsamen Zeitachse arbeiten.
Du baust enge Beziehungen zu führenden internationalen Robotik-Herstellern auf und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.
Du überzeugst Hersteller davon, gemeinsam mit RoboService den europäischen Markt aufzubauen, und vertrittst RoboService souverän gegenüber internationalen Partnern.
Du verhandelst Preise, Lieferkonditionen und kommerzielle Rahmenbedingungen und sorgst dafür, dass Roboter, Greifer, Sensorik und andere kritische Komponenten rechtzeitig verfügbar sind.
Du steuerst Bestellungen, Liefertermine und Bestände und behältst dabei Kundenprojekte und zukünftige Bedarfe im Blick.
Du baust klare, pragmatische Prozesse für Projektplanung, Lieferantenmanagement, Inventar und Operations auf und entwickelst diese mit unserem Wachstum weiter.
Ein externer Compliance-Spezialist berichtet zunächst an dich.
Mit unserem Wachstum kannst du weitere Verantwortung übernehmen, ein eigenes Team aufbauen und operative Aufgaben zunehmend delegieren.
Qualifikation
Wir suchen weniger nach einem bestimmten Lebenslauf als nach außergewöhnlichem Talent, hoher Lernfähigkeit und dem Willen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

In dieser Schlüsselposition übernimmst du die operative Führung unserer Betriebe mit Hauptfokus auf Kaiseraugst. Du berichtest direkt an den Geschäftsführer und führst rund 15–20 Mitarbeitende. Du führst nicht vom Büro aus, sondern bist dort präsent, wo der Betrieb läuft. Wenn du Teams mit Respekt und klarer Kante führst und Technik verstehst, bist du bei uns am richtigen Platz.

s.h: Deine Aufgaben – führen, organisieren und weiterentwickeln
s.t:
Betrieb führen: Du führst das operative Tagesgeschäft unserer Standorte mit Hauptfokus Kaiseraugst. Du planst den täglichen Mitarbeiter\- und Maschineneinsatz, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass der Betrieb reibungslos läuft.
Team führen: Du leitest rund 15–20 Mitarbeitende (Platzchef, Maschinisten, Sortier\-/Betriebspersonal, Waage) mit klarer, fairer und verlässlicher Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.
Materialflüsse koordinieren: Du behältst den Überblick über Annahme, Klassierung, Sortierung, Lagerung und Abtransport unserer Wertstoffe und Abfälle und stellst sicher, dass Materialien zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind.
Betrieb weiterentwickeln: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale in Abläufen, Organisation und Technik und setzt diese gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung pragmatisch um.
Maschinenpark im Schuss halten: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bagger, Radlader, Stapler, Pressen, Schredder sowie Aufbereitungs\- und Sortieranlagen einsatzbereit, gewartet und gepflegt sind. Grössere Reparaturen sprichst du mit externen Partnern ab.
Platz \& Sicherheit: Du schaust auf Sauberkeit, Struktur und Ordnung auf dem gesamten Areal und setzt Sicherheits\-, Umwelt\- und Brandschutzregeln konsequent durch.
Verantwortung übernehmen: Du vertrittst den Geschäftsführer bei Abwesenheit und bringst deine Ideen bei Neuanschaffungen und Projekten ein.
Das bringst du mit – Führung, Technik und gesunder Menschenverstand:
Berufsausbildung: Abgeschlossene technische, handwerkliche oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
Weiterbildung: Eine Weiterbildung zum Technischen , Prozessfachmann, Betriebsfachmann oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil.
Führungserfahrung: Führungserfahrung in einem operativen Umfeld mit unterschiedlich qualifizierten Mitarbeitenden ist besonders willkommen. Du kommunizierst direkt, respektvoll, klar und lässt dich auch in hektischen Momenten nicht aus der Ruhe bringen.
Hands\-on\-Mentalität: Du packst Probleme pragmatisch an, entscheidest und organisierst gerne und bist im Betrieb sichtbar und präsent.
Wohnort: Dein Wohnort ermöglicht dir eine zuverlässige Präsenz in Kaiseraugst.
Führerschein: Führerausweis Kat. B ist Pflicht; Baumaschinenausweis und/oder Maschinistenpraxis sind ein Plus.
Branchenerfahrung: Erfahrung im Recycling\-, Schüttgut\- oder Baustellenbereich ist von Vorteil – motivierte Quereinsteiger mit solider Führungspraxis sind willkommen!

Viel Freiraum: Hohe Eigenverantwortung und echtes Vertrauen in deine tägliche Arbeit.
Schlüsselposition: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen und kannst den Betrieb aktiv mitgestalten.
Abwechslungsreicher Betrieb: Unterschiedliche Materialien, Maschinen, Anlagen und Standorte sorgen dafür, dass kein Tag genau gleich aussieht.
Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Ein wirtschaftlich gesundes, regional verankertes KMU mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und langjährigen Mitarbeitenden.
Moderne Technik: Gute Maschinen und zeitgemässe Recyclinganlagen.
Klare Verantwortlichkeiten: Administration, ISO\-System, Budgetierung und Fuhrparkmanagement werden durch andere Stellen unterstützt bzw. verantwortet – du kannst dich auf die operative Führung der Betriebe konzentrieren.
Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen: 5 Wochen Ferien, gute Sozialleistungen und faire, marktgerechte Anstellungsbedingungen.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Sende uns deine Bewerbung bitte direkt. Deine Bewerbung behandeln wir selbstverständlich vertraulich. Auf die Bewerbungsadresse hat ausschliesslich der Geschäftsführer Zugriff.
(Hinweis: Wir berücksichtigen ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen. Dossiers von Personalvermittlern können wir nicht bearbeiten.)

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000
Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.
You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You'll set one consistent set of rules and make them stick across the entire business. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.
This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.
There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective about what the figures say. We've positioned the salary to reflect both your seniority and the independence you'll need to challenge senior leaders professionally and diplomatically when the numbers don't match the narrative.

s.h: HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON
s.t:
Building and maintaining complete visibility across the entire revenue line: marketing pipeline, sales pipeline, churn and renewals, and capacity planning.
Setting and enforcing a single set of definitions and rules across marketing, sales and customer success, then making them stick.
Owning HubSpot end-to-end: permissions, day-to-day usage, workflow build, automations and the processes that keep data clean at source.
Producing forecasts, headcount plans and reporting that the leadership team can actually rely on.
Contributing to the design of commission plans and commercial structures.
Supporting the hiring and onboarding of a Sales Operations person, and training them to maintain what you've built.
Presenting to the board, with numbers that are clean, consistent and defensible.
Using AI to solve problems that would otherwise drown you in manual work.
Joining up the revenue line with the wider business (think product, finance, and marketing) so everybody's working from the same playbook.

You've owned reporting across a full commercial funnel (not just the sales pipeline). You can point to a forecast you owned, a commission plan you shaped and workflows you built yourself.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.
Floor Execution & Quality Standards
Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.
Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts — directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets.
Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards — inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team.
Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.

Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift — task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations.
Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst, Account Management at Vanta, you will support the day-to-day operations and strategic execution of our global Account Management organization. You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and AM leadership to improve forecasting, pipeline generation, renewals, expansion, book management, and overall operational rigor.
Revenue Operations at Vanta aims to unlock revenue for our GTM teams by building scalable processes, delivering actionable insights, and removing operational friction. Within Account Management, this means helping our teams retain and grow customers while creating the operating infrastructure and visibility leaders need to run the business effectively.
Success in this role is determined by your ability to operate with speed and precision, turn data into actionable insights, build strong partnerships with the field, and continuously improve how our Account Management organization operates.
What you’ll do as a GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst, Account Management at Vanta:
Serve as a key operational partner to Account Managers and AM leadership, helping resolve day-to-day operational questions and escalations related to account ownership, Rules of Engagement, renewals, expansion, pipeline, and GTM data.
Own and support the AM operating rhythm, including recurring forecast and pipeline preparation, business reviews, scorecards, and performance reporting.
Inspect renewal, expansion, pipeline, and retention performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate those findings into clear recommendations for AM leadership.
Run recurring audits across pipeline, opportunities, account books, forecasting, and CRM hygiene to improve data quality and operating discipline.
Support book management and account movement, ensuring account ownership and territory changes are executed accurately and consistently.
Partner with AM leadership to improve pipeline generation and expansion motions, including tracking performance against targets and identifying opportunities to improve conversion and execution.
Develop and maintain source-of-truth reporting and operating metrics for Account Managers and leaders, primarily within Salesforce and other GTM systems.
Partner closely with Systems, Analytics, Finance, Deal Desk, and other Revenue Operations teams to identify and implement process and tooling improvements.
Manage competing priorities across recurring operational responsibilities and strategic projects, communicating tradeoffs and ensuring deadlines are met.
Support cross-functional initiatives from requirements gathering through rollout, documentation, enablement, and ongoing adoption.

s.t:
Strong understanding of B2B SaaS post-sales and Account Management motions, including renewals, retention, expansion, forecasting, and pipeline management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify a business challenge, quantify its revenue or customer impact, and recommend a path forward.
Ability to move comfortably between day-to-day operational execution and broader process improvement.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted partnerships with Account Managers and AM leadership.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
Strong attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy and operational execution.
Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and comfort analyzing large datasets.
Advanced Salesforce reporting and dashboard experience.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment while maintaining clear communication around progress, risks, and tradeoffs.
A mindset of continuous improvement—you look beyond completing the task at hand to identify how we can make the underlying process more scalable and effective.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

You will structure ambiguous opportunities, develop recommendations, align stakeholders, and move initiatives from concept through execution. You will also build the processes, tools, and operating rhythms needed to scale successful programs.
Based in our San Francisco headquarters, this is a highly visible individual contributor role that works with Cloudflare executives, customers, external partners, and teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Workplace, and IT.

Own relationships with catering, gifting, hotel, and transportation vendors; establish service standards, coordinate delivery, and manage spend against budget.
Partner with Workplace, IT, Sales, Customer Success, and other teams to deliver a seamless guest experience, resolve issues, and improve the broader office experience.
Develop reusable templates, training, playbooks, and personalized briefing materials that improve program quality and scalability.
Use feedback, program data, and stakeholder input to identify opportunities and lead improvements to the EBC operating model.
Define and report monthly success metrics, customer insights, program performance, and recommendations to leadership.
Strategy, Operations, and Special Projects
Lead cross-functional special projects based on evolving company, customer, and executive priorities.
Develop and manage strategic events and programs from concept through execution, measurement, and improvement.
Support business development initiatives through opportunity research, partner evaluation, business-case development, and cross-functional coordination.
Build scalable processes, tools, and operating rhythms that improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
Step into high-priority initiatives where additional strategy, structure, or execution leadership is needed.

5+ years of experience in strategy and operations, program management, business development, strategic events, consulting, customer programs, or another highly cross-functional role.
Very strong project management skills and can identify and solve problems quickly with minimal management guidance
Outstanding customer service mentality and attention to detail
Ability to engage up and down the organization (including SVP+) with confidence, poise and gravitas.
Highly organized and self-motivated to create and execute on new projects
Team player who can take on projects in various stages of completion and run
Comfort in ambiguity of changing priorities and flexibility to new ideas within a fast paced environment
Strong attention to detail and craftsmanship, with a knack for prioritization and scoping
Curiosity about how things work, with the ability to anticipate problems or spot areas for improvements.
Experience building trusted advisor relationships with senior management
Possesses exceptional written and interpersonal communication skills, and able explain your work clearly and concisely to stakeholders

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
3-5 years experience in program coordination, executive events, events coordination, or customer-facing roles

We're looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented and hands-on individual to join the Revenue Team as a Manager, Revenue Operations. This role will be based in our Palo Alto, CA office and will support the execution and scaling of revenue operations in a high-growth, multi-product environment. This is a highly visible individual contributor role with significant ownership across revenue close, technical accounting, and cross-functional initiatives.
This is a great opportunity to join and grow with a strong accounting team at a high growth, enterprise software company!
The Revenue team is an extremely visible, high-performing team, ultimately responsible for accurate financial reporting of revenue. The team is responsible for managing the monthly close, contract negotiation and documentation, and determining appropriate accounting treatment for our product offerings.

Additionally, this team is responsible for designing and maintaining controls over reporting of revenue and assisting in quarterly revenue forecasting activities. This role will report directly to the Senior Manager of Revenue.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Palo Alto for our hybrid working model.
Position Expectations
Participate in month-end close activities comprising various revenue analyses, booking JEs, account reconciliations and revenue recognition
Analyze sales transactions within the Company’s ERP systems to ensure accuracy of data and integrity of revenue schedules, inclusive of revenue allocations
Review and validate all revenue streams for appropriate revenue treatments
Review contract write-ups and provide guidance on revenue treatment under ASC 606 and related financial reporting requirements to ensure appropriate revenue recognition
Experience establishing, maintaining, and reviewing standalone selling price ranges and methodologies
Manage the execution of quarterly reviews and year-end financial audits by external auditors
Provide functional oversight to Revenue Analysts, including reviewing work and offering guidance to support growth and development
Assist in the review and delivery of executive-level analytics and revenue disclosures by analyzing complex data sets, identifying trends, anomalies, and underlying drivers, and applying sound judgment to translate findings into actionable insights
Work cross-functionally with key internal business partners, such as OTC and FP&A on ongoing initiatives
Assist with special projects and ad hoc requests as required

Bachelor's degree in Accounting (CPA preferred) with at least 8+ years of experience in a similar role at public, high-growth SaaS or technology company
Prior experience with revenue operations, revenue recognition and reconciliation processes including working with sales data, customer contracts and new product offerings
Working knowledge of ASC 606, including application of SaaS and usage-based revenue models.
Proficiency in MS Excel and working with large volumes of data
Knowledge of ERP and CRM systems (NetSuite, Salesforce)
Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills
Acute attention to detail and well-developed organization
Excellent time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Ability to take ownership of complex revenue areas, influence cross-functional partners, and independently drive projects to completion
Must be self-motivated, flexible and deadline-oriented
Outstanding interpersonal, communication, and business partnering skills with demonstrated ability to work cross functionally at various levels within the company
Success Measures
A successful candidate must have the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, global environment as well as have experience and a strong interest in revenue operation processes
In 30 days, a successful candidate will have become familiar with our business, product offerings, and revenue streams
In 3 to 6 months, you’ll have become familiar with our internal systems, operational workflows and accounting close tasks assigned to you and would be performing them independently
In 6 to 9 months, you’ll have established relationships with key business partners such as Billing/OTC, FP&A and would be working directly with them as and when issues arise

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

The Sr. Business Operations Manager is a strategic partner to the leadership of Samsara’s Global Support organization, driving operational excellence and enabling data-informed decision-making at scale. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, supporting senior leadership with the insights, communications, and operational frameworks needed to run and grow the business effectively.
This role owns the annual operating plan and the operating cadence that measures performance against it.

On the planning side, you will own the capacity, headcount, and cost model that connects support volume, productivity, AI deflection, and staffing assumptions into a defensible operating plan — and act as the connective tissue between Support leadership, Workforce Management, and Finance.

On the business operations side, you will own the reporting and business review cadence for Customer Support, turning a wide set of operational metrics into a clear narrative about what is happening, why, and what leadership should do about it.
This is a high-autonomy role for a builder. You will take ambiguous, loosely scoped problems: a cost target, a capacity gap, an unexplained trend, and return with structured analysis, a defensible model, and a recommendation leaders can act on.

You will operate credibly with senior stakeholders across Support, Finance, and People, influence without direct authority, and use modern AI tools every day to work at a level of speed and rigor that would not otherwise be possible.

Success in this role looks like leaders making better decisions faster, with a plan and a set of numbers everyone trusts.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own the annual operating plan (AOP) for the Support organization end to end: building and maintaining the capacity, headcount, and cost model that translates volume forecasts, productivity, AI deflection, and staffing assumptions into a defensible operating plan and budget.
Model and pressure-test the strategic levers available to the business: headcount and vendor/BPO mix, cost to serve, deflection and automation impact, service level and coverage tradeoffs — and bring leadership clear recommendations with quantified impact and stated assumptions.
Own the Customer Support business review cadence (monthly and quarterly reviews) end to end: metric definition and data validation, executive narrative and insight, and follow-through on the decisions and actions that come out of it.
Build and maintain the reporting frameworks and metric definitions leaders run the business on — productivity, cost to serve, CSAT, time to resolution, deflection — and make them self-serve so managers can answer their own questions.
Partner with Support leaders on the operating programs that turn plan into behavior, including productivity and incentive program design, capacity allocation, and operational improvement initiatives that measurably improve efficiency and customer experience.
Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude) and self-service data capabilities on a day-to-day basis to accelerate modeling, analysis, narrative generation, and reporting — and raise the bar for how the broader operations team applies them.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

10+ years of experience in business operations, strategic finance/FP&A, management consulting, strategy, or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year accredited university.
Experience owning an annual operating plan, capacity plan, or equivalent multi-quarter planning process for a large organization or function.
Demonstrated experience building and owning complex operating or financial models (headcount, capacity, and cost) that senior leaders make decisions from.
Experience owning a recurring executive business review cadence (e.g., MBR/QBR) end to end, including metric definitions, narrative, and follow-through.
Demonstrated ability to build executive-level presentations and strategic communications that convey a clear, compelling narrative.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently source, interpret, and synthesize large and imperfect datasets to support decision-making, including familiarity with data tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, SQL, Databricks) for self-serve analytics.
Comfort and previous experience using AI tools for analysis, modeling, content generation, and workflow automation.
Experience working cross-functionally and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
High degree of independence and intellectual curiosity: able to take a loosely defined problem and return with structured, rigorous thinking and actionable recommendations.
Experience in or with a customer support, technical support, or service delivery organization operating at scale across multiple sites and a vendor/BPO mix.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Market Strategy & Entry
Define and prioritize Mexico market entry and expansion priorities based on regulatory readiness, fraud landscape, and addressable market size.

Revenue & Pipeline

Establish operational playbooks for how Sardine enters, scales, and retains customers in Mexico.

Partner with Account Management on strategic enterprise accounts, executive business reviews, and expansion opportunities.
Represent the voice of Mexican customers by translating customer feedback, fraud trends, and regional requirements into product and market strategy.

Deep understanding of Mexico's regulatory, compliance, and fraud landscape.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success.
Fluent in Spanish and English; willingness to travel within the region as needed.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic candidate to provide exceptional Customer service management to the Airbnb community as a Partner Operations Manager, Mandarin . The ideal candidate is hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service through partner and service management.
The Partner Operations Manager, Mandarin is supporting the global Delivery function by driving partner and service performance. Their organization skills, stakeholder management as well as performance analysis & management must be best-in-class. Accountable and responsible for the holistic performance of a partner or service or languageEnable and oversee a strong operational environment for your partners and services and ensure high quality support for the community from your partners
Set up for success your partner / service to deliver exceptional quality support to our community
Prioritise high impact focus areas with your partner/service in line with the company strategy
Actively work with core internal functions such as Quality, Workforce planning, Training to understand insights on performance and based on them, action within your partner / service
Act as a single point of contact, representing your partner / service across Delivery and CS
Present & report up on performance & progress to leadership across Delivery and CS
Hold partners accountable for the delivery of Airbnb goals
Own end to end the operationalization and successful adoption of new initiatives, projects and changes that impact your partner or service or language
Ensure alignment with Global CS Delivery
Input collectively with other ROMs to Sr Management and into the global delivery business reviews to provide a complete performance narrative to our leadership
Collaborate with your peers to ensure consistency & scalability in Global Delivery
Support and drive strategic initiatives within Delivery and your service
Identify and drive partner and service level continuous improvement opportunities that enhance performance, both day to day tactical and strategic forward looking
Collect feedback and be the voice of our community and partners to improve performance and optimize processes for the partner, service and global community
As required, collaborate with and understand the needs of your regional market and provide support to market managers and local business operations.
Collaborate with internal function such as BPI, PMO, Product on the launch of initiatives, projects and changes to bring improvements to your partner or service and mitigate potential risks

Your background & experience
A minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in a customer service or an operations role with 5+ years in a partner management, BPO environment
Demonstrable experience in driving improved performance as a partner/Regional Operations manager
Experience in the deployment of resources to manage real-time crisis situations, including managing high severity/sensitivity cases and decision-making authority for losses
Experience in data analysis and reporting to identify performance trends, as well as developing and implementing performance management standards
Demonstrable experience translating big picture goals and strategy into implementable and concrete actions for your partners
Ability to work weekend days and on-call required
Able to travel in Europe, APAC and NA when required
Your skills & expertise
Exceptional partner and stakeholder management - In depth understanding of business process outsourcing at scale, holding partners accountable for their performance and prioritizing the high impact areas
Exceptional performance management at scale - setting clear goals, expectations and actions while continuously driving success metrics
Strong data driven decision making with root cause analysis - ability to understand the data to derive to objective decisions
Strong communication, data driven storytelling and influencing skills - to present to leadership and collaborate with different stakeholders and manage time sensitive situations, while remaining calm and poised under pressure
Organized, structured and resourceful - able to juggle and multi-task, with an attention to detail and follow through even in ambiguous situations
Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities at scale - to evaluate procedures and identify opportunities for improvement
Strong proficiency in various data analysis and reporting tools to track performance trends (tableau, salesforce, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, etc.)

This is a broad, hands-on role at the centre of the People Team, and the first point of contact for colleagues in London and across Europe. Around half your time goes on core People Operations: systems, records, documentation and the employee lifecycle. A quarter is spent advising managers and employees on everyday employee relations matters.

The remaining quarter supports Workplace Experience: keeping our London office running well and helping deliver events people actually want to come to. This role is hybrid and requires presence on-site for 3 days a week in our London office in Moorgate.
It suits someone who enjoys variety and is equally comfortable handling a sensitive ER case in the morning, cleaning up HRIS data in the afternoon, and setting up for an all-hands the next day. You will get exposure across the whole People function and the chance to contribute real deliverables from day one. Here’s how you’ll contribute:
People Operations
Be the first point of contact for employee queries, resolving them through our case management system or pointing people to the information they need.
Maintain our People Systems, keeping people records accurate, delivering timely data to Payroll, and meeting government and legal compliance requirements.
Maintain HR documentation, including personnel files in hard copy, shared drives and the HRIS; create and distribute contracts, letters and employment confirmations.
Own the administrative side of the employee lifecycle: offers, contracts, onboarding, changes, family leave and leavers.
Coordinate onboarding so new joiners have everything they need to succeed on their first day, and run Day 1 Orientation for London starters.
Track spend against People budgets and support purchasing, vendor set-up and invoice processing.
Partner with teams across the People organisation to deliver projects, improve processes and drive efficiencies in areas such as learning and development, career growth, performance management, employer branding and communications, wellbeing and mental health, and diversity and inclusion.
Leverage AI tools to speed up routine drafting, summarising and tracking, while maintaining strong judgement around accuracy and confidentiality.
Employee Relations and Advisory
Act as first-line advisor on employee relations matters: absence and sickness, probation, flexible working requests, performance concerns, grievances and disciplinaries. You’ll triage cases and handle straightforward ones end to end.
Own the ER case log: record every case, track it through to resolution, and keep notes and documentation to an audit-ready standard.
Prepare ER documentation such as invite letters, outcome letters and settlement paperwork, and take minutes at formal hearings.
Coach line managers through everyday people conversations, escalating complex, high-risk or multi-jurisdiction cases to the People Partner.

🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!
At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people .
Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.
Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital , with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.
As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!

s.h: 💡 Your Mission: Turn growth into a system!
s.t:
Hi, I'm Jeremy, I lead RevOps at voize. I'm hiring the person who owns sales operations as we scale: new markets, new segments, and a sales team growing fast in all of them.
As Sales Operations Manager, you build the GTM engine that carries us past €100M ARR, working in close partnership with our sales leaders, with genuinely good tooling and AI ways of working behind you. Joining at this point in our hyper-growth journey is rare: big enough that the problems are real, early enough that you shape how they get solved. What you build now compounds for years, and so does your scope.
This role is roughly 60% building new process and 40% running what exists. If you want a mature machine to optimize, this is not it. If you want to design the machine, for now and for what comes next, it is.
🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike
Territory, compensation & capacity. Own the global account, territory and book-of-business model. Carve books for new AEs, keep segmentation honest as we add hospitals and new geos, and build the capacity and quota model that underpins our fiscal plan.
Forecasting. Run the forecast process end to end with our VP Sales and team leads: weekly hygiene, submit and roll-up, quarterly commit. Diagnose why deals slip, and stand the process up in the US, France and UK as those teams ramp.
Insights the company acts on. Define the sales metrics we run on, then turn pipeline and funnel data into the analysis that steers board meetings, monthly GTM reviews and weekly deal inspection. You define what gets measured; our data and BI team build the layer underneath.
Commercial process. Design how non-standard deals are managed at voize. You set the rules and stand the function up; you will not be the approval queue.
Process and tool enablement. In close collaboration with sales enablement, you make sure what gets built actually gets adopted, partnering with leaders, AEs and SDRs to prioritize the work with the most impact.
The GTM stack, built AI-first. Own the sales side of CRM and the tools around it. Automate the manual layer with Claude, n8n and whatever else earns its place, and take a real position on which tooling we buy next as we scale.

s.h: 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table
s.t:
3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or GTM strategy , at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or in strategy/tech consulting, VC or M&A before an operating role. You have seen what breaks as a sales team scales, because you were the one who fixed it.
Exceptional stakeholder skills. You partner with VPs and team leads as an equal, push back with evidence, and get change adopted by people who do not report to you.
Sharp analytical instincts and deep CRM fluency. Expert in spreadsheets, comfortable reading data in a BI tool, and you have owned a HubSpot or Salesforce instance rather than just worked in one. You go deep on data enrichment and spot the patterns that keep our data model trustworthy.
You have supported forecasting. You can talk methodology, where it broke, and what you changed. Same for a territory or quota plan you built and aligned with sales leadership.
Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on. You are comfortable with no playbook, you prioritize ruthlessly, and you ship rather than produce recommendations.
AI-native as a builder, not just a user. You already use Claude, n8n or similar to remove manual work from your own day, and you can point to something concrete you shipped that way.
🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize
We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will take on real problems, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people
We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany
Become a co-creator of our success with stock options
Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses
You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.
✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀
We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

Strong analytical skills; comfortable building and interpreting pipeline models, pacing dashboards, and funnel analyses. SQL or equivalent data querying experience a plus.
Experience designing and running a rhythm of business (WBR, QBR, or equivalent) for a sales or revenue-generating team.
Proven ability to translate complex data into clear executive narratives and drive decisions across senior stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; able to drive alignment across Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations.
Highly organized with a track record of building repeatable, scalable processes.

The challenge
We assess businesses in minutes and send funds in as little as 24 hours. That only works if the systems behind it are fast, reliable, and built to scale as we push into new markets. Right now, that means untangling recurring problems across Underwriting, Product, and Sales, and building the automations that stop them coming back.
What you'll actually do
Root-cause the recurring problems that slow us down. You'll define your own KPIs, dig into self-sourced data, and take your findings straight to Director and VP-level leadership.
Build automations that solve a whole business domain, not a single ticket. You'll work across Jira, Hubspot, Pipedream, Tines, and Scriptrunner, and you'll own them end to end: scoping, building, testing, launching.
Run cross-functional projects from definition to delivery. You'll own the relationship with teams like Underwriting, Product & Engineering, and Sales globally, and manage dependencies that sit outside your own team.
Find the inefficiencies that span two or more business units before anyone asks you to. You'll help shape the team's roadmap and support teammates as they grow.
Build the AI layer on top of our existing workflows. Using tools like Claude and Tines' AI Agent actions, you'll build them to triage and resolve tickets, speed up routing, and add an intelligence layer on top of existing workflows, extending efforts like our ticket-scoping assistant and fraud-detection agents, not just tinkering alongside them.
What this role could turn into
This function moves people fast. Recent paths from this seat include a Senior Operations Manager role owning a full domain end to end, a Product Ops or Automation Lead role going deeper on the technical build, or a cross-functional leadership role managing a small team of Ops generalists.
Who thrives here
Someone who digs in when something breaks instead of escalating and waiting. You've done your own homework before you ask for help, and when you do ask, you bring options, not just the question. You're relentless about root cause, not just the symptom in front of you. You're sharp on prioritisation.

You know the difference between busy and useful, and you can explain why you said yes, no, or not yet in a way people accept. People also just like working with you. You're generous with your time and knowledge, and people are generous back. You care about diversity, equality, and inclusion, and you say something when we can do better.
We hire for range
You have 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally at a fast-paced start-up or scale-up, and you've owned projects independently end to end.

You can point to real examples of scoping, building, and owning workflow automations end-to-end (Jira, HubSpot, Pipedream, Tines, Scriptrunner or similar), not just supporting them, and of leading cross-functional teams to deliver solutions, including managing stakeholders outside your own team.

Hands-on SQL experience is required, along with knowledge of Python or another scripting language. You've applied AI tools like Claude or Cursor to go from idea to working code or automation, this is a requirement and we do it on a daily basis.

We care more about the trajectory you're on, though experience in financial services, fintech, or B2B is particularly interesting to us.
Location and working policy
📍 Dublin - hybrid (3 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

Payments at Gusto aren't just infrastructure — they're the reason people get paid on time, every time. Payment Operations sits within Gusto's Money team, a cross-functional group spanning Engineering, Product, and Operations that powers money movement across Gusto's growing product surface: core payroll, contractor payments, international money movement, and new business offerings like PEO.
As a Payment Operations Analyst, you'll own specific end-to-end payment workflows, resolve exceptions that require real judgment, and help make our systems more reliable and efficient over time. Gusto's payment surface area is expanding — and this team is at the center of that growth.
This is a role for someone who can shift from investigating a single misfired transaction to coordinating a response on a payment outage affecting thousands — and bring the same rigor to both. You think in systems. You hold partners accountable. You lead with curiosity and embrace AI as a core part of how you work.
You'll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Accounting, Risk, and CX — and you'll develop strong day-to-day relationships with Gusto's bank and payment partners. When something breaks or slows down, you're the one who drives it to resolution.

Support the payment lifecycle end-to-end
Own the operational layer of specific payment workflows — ACH processing, exception handling, refunds, collection re-debits, reconciliation. When something is off, you investigate, escalate where needed, and see it through to resolution. And when you see a pattern, you push to fix the root cause.
Build alongside Product and Engineering
Payment Operations doesn't just react — we shape how the systems work. You'll contribute to product specs, surface operational pain points, help define requirements, and participate in launches. You're a partner in building, not just a consumer of what gets shipped.
Close the loop on customer pain
Customer and CX feedback is signal. You actively mine it to identify friction in payment flows, prioritize what matters, and bring those insights into the operational and product conversations where decisions get made.
Think in systems
Connect the dots across rails, partners, reconciliation, compliance, and customer experience. When an issue surfaces, you understand how it ripples — and you bring that perspective to cross-functional conversations.
Hold partners to a high standard
Work directly with Gusto's bank and payment partners — domestic and international — to triage issues, resolve escalations, and maintain strong working relationships. You know how to be firm and collaborative at the same time, and you don't let things sit.
Lead with AI
You use AI as a genuine work partner — to move faster on analysis, draft communications, synthesize data, and automate the repetitive. You're always looking for the smarter way to get to the answer.

3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking operations, treasury operations, or a related role at a fintech or financial institution
Working knowledge of domestic payment rails (ACH/Nacha, wires, RTP) and/or international money movement (cross-border transfers, FX, global disbursement networks); experience across both is a strong plus
Strong analytical instincts — you look for the pattern behind the problem and can query or structure data to find it (SQL a plus but not required)
Experience working with bank portals, payment processors, or reconciliation tools
Ability to communicate clearly with both operational and technical counterparts; you can write a crisp Slack to an engineer and a professional escalation to a bank partner
Comfortable working in ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for perfect information
Eager to build AI into how you work — whether you're already using it daily or just getting started, you see it as a genuine productivity lever and are committed to developing that fluency
Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks (Nacha operating rules, unclaimed property, money transmission) is a strong plus

This is a broad, hands-on role at the center of the People Team, and the first point of contact for colleagues in Boston and across the Americas. A quarter is spent advising managers and employees on everyday employee relations matters.

The remaining quarter supports Workplace Experience: keeping our Boston office running well and helping deliver events people actually want to come to. This role is hybrid and requires presence on-site for 3 days a week in our Boston office.
It suits someone who enjoys variety and is equally comfortable handling a sensitive ER case in the morning, cleaning up HRIS data in the afternoon, and setting up for an all-hands the next day. You will get exposure across the whole People function and the chance to contribute real deliverables from day one. Here's how you'll contribute:
People Operations
Be the first point of contact for employee queries, resolving them through our case management system or pointing people to the information they need.
Maintain our People Systems, keeping people records accurate, delivering timely data to Payroll, and meeting federal, state and legal compliance requirements.
Maintain HR documentation, including personnel files in hard copy, shared drives and the HRIS; create and distribute offer letters, agreements and employment verifications.
Own the administrative side of the employee lifecycle: offers, agreements, onboarding, changes, leaves of absence and departures.
Coordinate onboarding so new joiners have everything they need to succeed on their first day, and run Day 1 Orientation for Boston starters.
Track spend against People budgets and support purchasing, vendor set-up and invoice processing.
Partner with teams across the People organization to deliver projects, improve processes and drive efficiencies in areas such as learning and development, career growth, performance management, employer branding and communications, wellbeing and mental health, and diversity and inclusion.
Leverage AI tools to speed up routine drafting, summarizing and tracking, while maintaining strong judgement around accuracy and confidentiality.
Employee Relations and Advisory
Act as first-line advisor on employee relations matters: absence and leave, performance concerns, accommodation requests, complaints and investigations. You'll triage cases and handle straightforward ones end to end.
Own the ER case log: record every case, track it through to resolution, and keep notes and documentation to an audit-ready standard.
Prepare ER documentation such as invite letters, outcome letters and separation paperwork, and take minutes at formal meetings.
Coach line managers through everyday people conversations, escalating complex, high-risk or multi-jurisdiction cases to the People Partner.
Provide Tier 1 policy interpretation, applying US federal and Massachusetts employment law and Scandit policy consistently and fairly.
Spot patterns across cases and flag recurring themes to the People Partner so we fix causes, not just symptoms.
Support policy work, drafting and reviewing policies, keeping the handbook current, and helping roll out changes with clear guidance for managers.
Workplace Experience and Events
Keep the Boston office running smoothly: supplies, kitchen stock, non-IT equipment, shared spaces and equipment, all in line with health and safety standards.
Coordinate in-person, virtual and hybrid events, including team meetings, training sessions, workshops, hackathons, global ESG programs and all-company celebrations.
Handle event logistics, including room bookings, catering, A/V, signage, transport, parking and accessibility needs, and support day-of set-up, check-in, troubleshooting and breakdown.
Manage attendee communications: invitations, RSVPs, registration lists, reminders and post-event follow-up.
Build strong working relationships with building management, tenants and vendors, and maintain vendor lists, contracts and invoices.
Oversee swag and office and event inventory for new hires and upcoming events, including ordering, storage and distribution.
Support the Global Team Outing and other Workplace Experience projects alongside the wider team.

**Amplifon ist** **Qualitätsanbieter und weltweit führender Spezialist für Hörlösungen mit mehr als 75 Jahren Erfahrung. Unsere Passion ist positive Kundenerlebnisse zu schaffen und die Lebensqualität unserer Kunden mit Angeboten und Serviceleistungen rund ums Hören zu verbessern. In der Schweiz sind wir mit über 100 Fachgeschäften vertreten.**
**Für unser Marketing Team am Hauptsitz in Baar (ZG), suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung einen CRM \& Customer Operations Manager (D/E/F).**
Als CRM \& Customer Operations Manager bist du verantwortlich für die Optimierung und Orchestrierung von crossmedialen Kampagnen mit Fokus auf Kundenbindung und \-aktivierung entlang der ganzen Customer Journey.

Dabei analysierst du die Customer\-Experience, die verschiedenen Touchpoints, sowie die Prozess\- und Datenqualität und partizipierst aktiv an der datengetriebenen Generierung von Handlungsempfehlungen für Kampagnen.

Du bist verantwortlich für die Weiterentwicklung der CRM\-Strategie sowie das Auf\- und Umsetzen von Kampagnen in Adobe Campaign und interagierst mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen.
Eine wichtige Grundlage der Tätigkeit bildet dabei auch die Definition von KPIs zur Erfolgskontrolle und die Erstellung ganzheitlicher Trackingkonzepte für die einzelnen Touchpoints der Customer Journeys und Begleitung derer Implementierung.
**Deine Aufgaben**
* Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung der CRM\-Strategie zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Kundenbindung, Aktivierung und Lifetime Value.
* Verantwortlich für die Konzeption, das Aufsetzen und den operativen Betrieb von Kampagnen sowie die Entwicklung effektiver Customer Journeys und Automatisierungsprogramme in Adobe Campaign.
* Eigenständige Umsetzung von CRM\-Kampagnen in Adobe Campaign inklusive Testing, Versandsteuerung, Monitoring und Optimierung.
* Unterstützung und fachliche Begleitung von Consultants im Bereich Adobe Campaign sowie enge Zusammenarbeit bei System\- und Prozessweiterentwicklungen.
* Verbesserung der Kundenbindung und \-aktivierung entlang des gesamten Customer Funnels durch datengetriebene CRM\-Massnahmen.
* Definition relevanter Zielgruppen unter Berücksichtigung geeigneter Segmentierungs\- und Personalisierungsmethoden sowie Bereitstellung der Daten für die zielgerichtete Kundenansprache.
* Analyse, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der Bestandskundendaten sowie nachhaltiger Ausbau des Kundenstamms und Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität.
* Laufende Überwachung, Analyse und Reporting der Kampagnen\-Performance sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen zur Optimierung.
* Verantwortung für das Management und die Steuerung des externen Kundenservice\-Centers.
* Schnittstelle zu lokalen und internationalen Stakeholdern, Corporate Teams, Consultants und IT\-Verantwortlichen für Weiterentwicklungen, Systemunterstützung und Prozessoptimierungen.
* Fachliche Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines kleinen Teams im Bereich Customer Call Center und CRM Operations.
**Dein Profil**
* Abgeschlossenes Studium (FH, Uni, HF) in Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung.
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im CRM\-, Omni\-Channel\- oder Dialogmarketing sowie im Kampagnen\-Management.
* Praktische Erfahrung im Aufsetzen, Steuern und Optimieren von Kampagnen in Adobe Campaign oder vergleichbaren Marketing\-Automation\-Tools.
* Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis von CRM\-, ERP\- und Marketing\-Automation\-Systemen sowie von kanalübergreifenden Kundenkommunikations\- und Kampagnenprozessen (u. a. E\-Mail, Print und Call Center).
* Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement sowie im Incident\- und Prozessmanagement von Vorteil.
* Erfahrung mit Datenanalysen, Segmentierungen und Reporting.
* Ausgeprägte Affinität zu datengetriebenem Marketing, Customer Journeys, Marketing Automation und Data Analytics.
* Analytische, konzeptionelle und kommunikative Stärke sowie strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise.
* Hohe Lösungsorientierung, Eigeninitiative und ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Projekt\- und Prozessmanagement.
* Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative und Begeisterung für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse.
* Erfahrung in conversion\-orientierten Vertriebs\- und Marketingstrukturen von Vorteil.
* Erste Führungserfahrung kleiner Teams
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
**Was wir bieten**
* Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben und selbstständiges Arbeiten in einem jungen, sympathischen und hochmotivierten Team.
* Ein dynamisches Unternehmen, bei dem du deine Ideen entwickeln kannst und das dir attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen anbietet.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

s.h: BUSINESS OPERATIONS ANALYST, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARLINK AVIATION)
s.t:
One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, Starlink is leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the world's most advanced broadband internet system and largest satellite constellation to provide fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide, connect humanity, and fund Mars colonization.

Starlink business operations combines traditional planning and analysis with broader business decision-making and strategy, directly supporting SpaceX’s leadership. Business operations is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near-term execution and long-term planning.

Team members are expected to analyze data and provide recommendations and to lead cross-functional decision-making and implementation of the recommendations. Starlink business operations is lean and dynamic, operating with a fluid structure that favors high agency.

We expect high performers to expand their scope across the program’s most critical bottlenecks.

Own global S&OP (sales & operations planning) for Starlink Aviation to convert hardware into active, happy, paying customers
Analyze key performance indicators, especially active subscribers, network utilization, produce-to-activate latency, inventory turnover, and hardware unit economics (CAC, payback period); includes developing complex S&OP models and decision-making tools
Translate analysis into strategic insights and hardware mix strategy to accelerate hardware adoption, maximize lifetime value, and minimize working capital
Orchestrate global supply allocation and demand forecasting by synthesizing complex demand signals against dynamic capacity constraints, working directly with Engineering
Drive resource planning for specific verticals, including the execution of critical hardware ramp and sunset plans in close collaboration with Hardware & Manufacturing Engineering
Enable and accelerate go-to-market execution for products post-licensing and certification to ensure zero-latency deployment
Identify initiatives for improvement of Starlink’s operational trajectory, including developing, tracking, and executing business initiatives with SpaceX’s leadership

Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, data science, physics, business, or supply chain
1+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, product management, operations, FP&A, consulting, banking, or entrepreneurship
1+ years of experience in Excel or programming

Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment
Quantitative dual degree in engineering field and economics or business field and/or equivalent professional experience
Demonstrated success driving tangible impact/influencing within a broader organization
Extreme sense of urgency and ownership; bias toward action and automation
Ability to read and interpret income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python; ability to handle large datasets independently
Excellent analytical modeling skills (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior business leaders

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel to customer sites, other SpaceX locations, and events as needed

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year.

Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

s.t: Starlink is providing high-speed broadband to the world. This role combines traditional business planning and analysis with broader business decision-making and strategy, directly supporting Starlink's leadership. Global Operations is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near-term execution and long-term planning. Team members are expected to analyze data and provide recommendations and to lead cross-functional decision-making and implementation of the recommendations.

Develop comprehensive execution plan to implement market requirements for initial market access and rapid growth of operations
Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as the timeliness of activation upon full authorization in a market, product accessibility, and Starlink’s operational health in live markets
Guide planning and resource management for specific verticals within Starlink, including development of business models
Identify initiatives for improvement of Starlink's business outlook, including developing, tracking, and executing business initiatives with Starlink's leadership
Identify and lead implementation of process and system enhancements to improve handoffs and execution across various teams, evolve the customer experience, or scale the business while balancing resources
Collaborate and partner with cross functional teams in order to build a strong networking across these departments and with external resources to ensure compliance
Support and educate internal stakeholders on market requirements and timeframes, working collaboratively to achieve company objectives

Bachelor’s degree in STEM, business, economics, or finance
4+ years of experience in business operations, project management, or strategic planning
1+ year experience based abroad or working with operations outside of the United States
1+ year of experience with analytical skills (e.g. Microsoft Office applications, Excel modeling, etc.)

Demonstrated success working in an environment with competing priorities and aggressive schedules
Experience leading complex operational and strategic initiatives
Ability to define and manage a project independently
Experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
Experience using various programming languages (e.g Python, Javascript, R, SQL, HTML, XML, CSS, Ruby)
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior business leaders

Willingness to travel up to 50%
Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends
This is not a remote position and would require being onsite

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00
