At Minnesota Cannabis Services, we’re not just building businesses — we’re building the people who make them great. Our team partners with leading operators across cultivation, manufacturing, distribution, and retail to deliver world-class expertise in legal, finance, analytics, marketing, HR, and technology.
We’re looking for professionals who take pride in their work, move with purpose, and thrive in fast-changing environments. The kind of people who hold themselves to high standards, think creatively, and find satisfaction in solving hard problems.
When you join our team, you’ll work alongside some of the most experienced leaders in the industry — professionals who share their knowledge freely and lead by example. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to take ownership of meaningful work that shapes the future of one of the fastest-growing industries in America.
At Minnesota Cannabis Services , we’re building more than businesses — we’re building leaders. Our General Managers are the cornerstone of our retail operations, leading high-performing teams that deliver best-in-class customer experiences across one of the fastest-growing industries in the country.
As a General Manager, you’ll oversee all aspects of store performance — from daily operations, compliance, and financial reporting to team development and customer engagement. You’ll set the tone for excellence, drive growth through data-driven decision-making, and create a culture where people take pride in their work and deliver exceptional results every day.

Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of managers and associates to exceed operational and financial goals.
Oversee scheduling, cash and inventory management, visual merchandising, and compliance.
Champion a culture of accountability, communication, and continuous improvement.
Develop and coach Assistant GMs, preparing them for future leadership roles.
Collaborate with corporate and cross-functional teams to optimize efficiency and customer satisfaction.
Ensure safety, consistency, and excellence in every facet of operations.

You’re a decisive, people-first leader with proven retail or multi-unit management experience. You thrive in dynamic environments, solve problems before they arise, and know how to build teams that win. You bring structure, energy, and focus to everything you do — and you expect the same from those around you.

At Minnesota Cannabis Services, you’ll have the opportunity to lead with autonomy while being part of a collaborative network of professionals shaping the future of cannabis. We offer competitive pay, benefits, advancement opportunities, and a culture built on trust, performance, and growth.
If you’re ready to lead from the front — and build something lasting — apply today.

5+ years of experience in multi-functional retail management with direct supervisory experience
Strong leadership and coaching abilities
Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Comfortable working with scheduling, inventory systems, and financial reporting
A high level of integrity, personal motivation, adaptability, and sense of urgency
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and managing sensitive information
Previous retail, sales and/or customer service experience is strongly preferred
We do not require previous professional experience in the cannabis industry but would prefer the applicant be a consumer of the product.
Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays
This position requires the ability to perform essential job functions such as standing, walking, bending, climbing, and lifting up to 50 pounds regularly (up to 200 pounds with assistance), with or without reasonable accommodation
Must commit to coming to work sober.
Successfully pass a pre-employment criminal background check
Minimum 21 years of age

Bonus incentives programs
Employee discount
Health, Dental and Vision insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Employee Discount Program offering exclusive discounts from top national retailers
Earned Sick & Safe Time (ESST) and Personal Time Off (PTO)
Holiday Pay for anyone working New Years Day, 4/20, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day
At Minnesota Cannabis Services, we believe great teams are built on trust, initiative, and follow-through. We invest deeply in our people — providing mentorship, on-the-job training, and opportunities for advancement across multiple sectors of the cannabis industry.
Here, you’ll be part of a high-performing culture that values precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. Every project is a chance to grow your skills, strengthen your leadership, and contribute to something that matters.
If you’re driven, resourceful, and ready to make an impact, we want you on our team. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Minnesota Cannabis Services.

You’ll be joining a team that delivers high‑quality e‑commerce data across more than 40 countries. We’re looking for a detail‑oriented, analytically minded Data Operations Analyst to be part of our dynamic, multicultural team. In this role, you’ll contribute to the entire data operations lifecycle—from validating, extracting, and processing digital transaction data to troubleshooting data quality issues and partnering with cross‑functional teams.
This is a great opportunity for early‑career professionals eager to build a solid foundation in data analysis within a client‑focused environment. You’ll also have the chance to drive new initiatives and continuous improvements.

If you enjoy solving puzzles, you’ll feel right at home: your logical thinking and analytical mindset will help you navigate complex challenges, identify patterns, and uncover insights. With constant learning at the core of this role, curiosity and ownership will be essential to your success.

Data Extraction
Build data extractors to parse e-receipts using NielsenIQ’s proprietary markup language and RegEx.
Debug and fine-tune templates to make sure they’re accurate, then validate your work with SQL and BI tools.
Keep documentation clear and communicate effectively with tech teams and client-facing teams.
Adapt extraction logic as data formats and business needs change.
Stay up to date with our internal processes and tools.
Data Quality & Analysis
Conduct comprehensive checks to ensure data is complete, accurate, consistent, and correctly parsed, leveraging BI tools and SQL.
Investigate anomalies and irregularities specific to transactional data.
Write and optimize SQL queries, and build dashboards to support large‑scale analysis.
Prepare clear, actionable reports for client‑facing teams.
Process Improvement
Spot opportunities for automation and help improve our processes and tools.
Support strategic projects aimed at improving operational workflows.
Work closely with developers, analysts and client-facing teams to design solutions together.
Keep operational and project documentation up to date.

First experience (internship, projects) in data operations, analytics or tech related roles.
Basic SQL skills: Ability to write simple queries to retrieve and inspect data; Can read and understand more complex queries written by others; Understands table structures, relationships, and how data is organized within a database.
A logical, analytical mindset to tackle complex tasks and spot patterns in data.
Great communication skills and attention to detail (crucial when working with data that people rely on to make decisions).
Fluency in English.

Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool like Tableau, Power BI, Looker etc.
Knowledge of e-commerce data and industry trends.
